correctness.rationale: In characteristic zero the nonic is three degree-one irreducible components plus irreducible degree-six component; image of a smooth conic under coordinate-cubing has generic degree one and degree six, proving irreducibility. Every projective stabilizer permutes the intrinsic three lines, hence is monomial. Comparing X^6,Y^6,Z^6 and mixed sextic coefficients forces diagonal squares equal, leaving 4 projective sign elements times S3=24. Direct expansion checks all 48 signed permutation linear matrices (24 projectively). Originating singularity list has 6 E7 and 7 nodes; signed permutations partition into orbits of 6, 4, 3, stabilizer sizes 4,6,8. No abstract or positive characteristic automorphism assertion.
